svg.text: Travel Itinerary Planning & Booking API - Entity Relationship Diagram
Not drawn for clarity: User -> Booking (bookings), User -> Review (reviews), Review -> Destination / Accommodation (exactly one target per review).
Legend: 1 = one, N = many, M2M = many-to-many, 0..1 = optional. Collaboration is the through model for Itinerary <-> User.
